description:
About our brand and products:
GOOBS makes pre-workout gummies for people who want energy and focus without the mess of powders. Our gummies are portable, easy to take, and built for people with busy routines who still want to perform. Instead of shaker bottles, scoops, and chalky drinks, GOOBS gives customers a grab-and-go gummy that tastes great and fits real life. GOOBS is built around convenience, flavor, and a smoother pre-workout experience.  

What makes us different:
Most pre-workout powders create friction. People complain about mixing, jitters, crashes, stomach issues, and bad taste. Many gummy competitors also get called out for weak formulas and poor flavor. GOOBS is different because it combines a candy-like format with real performance support, including caffeine and citicoline for energy and focus. It is a product creators can talk about easily because it solves a clear problem and feels different from typical supplements.  

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn commission on tracked sales generated through their personal code or affiliate link. This gives creators a simple way to monetize content while offering their audience an easy path to purchase. The better the content and conversion, the more the affiliate can earn.

How to promote us:
GOOBS works well in short-form video, gym content, lifestyle content, creator routines, gaming setups, and on-the-go daily content. Strong angles include replacing powder pre-workout, convenience, taste, portability, clean energy, and focus. Creators who show the product naturally and explain why it fits real life tend to be the best fit.

Other information:
We are looking for creators with real engagement, strong content, and audiences that align with fitness, gaming, lifestyle, and busy on-the-go routines. You do not need a massive following to be a fit. We care more about content quality, brand fit, and the ability to drive real sales.
